data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: (a) Exit-code propagation — Makefile rules MUST propagate non-zero exit from any sub-script (especially task-4 audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py) as Makefile failure. Use bash strict mode (set -e) in Makefile recipes OR use Make's default exit-on-error. Add RED test: mock task-4 to exit non-zero → make audit-phase exits non-zero with the same exit code. (b) e2e smoke test via dry-run — invoke 'make -n audit-live PHASE=bootstrap-throttle' (dry-run mode, prints execution plan without running); assert plan contains dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 in order. Validates DAG without side-effects.
